full_prompt_en: A square monochrome digital painting shows two faceless figures in formal dress against a charcoal studio background. The background is nearly black at the left and lower edges, while a restrained gray halo spreads behind the taller figure's head in the upper center. In the foreground on the left, a shorter figure faces forward with a smooth pale oval face and a sharply cut black bob. A broad horizontal black band crosses the face at eye level; there are no visible eyes, nose, or mouth. The dark garment has a simple rounded neckline and a narrow pale opening at the center of the chest. The head, neck, and upper torso emerge as clean, simplified volumes from the surrounding shadow. Behind and to the right stands a taller figure in a dark suit jacket, white shirt, and narrow black tie. A small pale line at the jacket pocket catches the eye near the lower right. The taller head is also an unmarked pale oval, interrupted by a black band across the upper face. Its softly modeled lower half narrows toward the neck, while the shoulder and lapel are formed with broad, quiet planes. The foreground figure overlaps the jacket and tie, making the pair read as a compact group rather than two isolated silhouettes. The pale faces carry the brightest values, the shirt and pocket detail supply smaller white accents, and the clothes sink into several degrees of charcoal. Light seems to arrive from the upper left, rounding the heads and leaving the far right side of the taller face and suit in deep shadow. The painted surface is smooth with faint grain and subtle tonal transitions; edges are crisp where the face meets the dark band and softer where dark clothing meets the background. The overall composition is still and tightly balanced, using stark black and white geometry to give the formal portrait a strange, restrained mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形单色调数字绘画呈现两名身着正式服装、没有五官的人物，背景是炭黑色影棚空间。背景在左侧和下缘近乎漆黑，较高人物头后方的上部中央则散开一圈克制的灰色光晕。左侧前景中，较矮人物正面站立，脸部是光滑的浅色椭圆形，黑色齐耳短发边缘剪裁整齐。一道宽阔的黑色横带从眼睛高度穿过脸部；眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴都不可见。深色衣服有简洁的圆领，胸口中央留下一道窄浅色开口。头部、颈部和上半身以干净简化的体块从周围阴影中浮现。后方偏右是一名较高人物，穿深色西装外套、白衬衫和窄黑领带。外套口袋处的一道浅色细线在右下区域引人注意。较高人物的头也是没有五官的浅色椭圆体，上半张脸被一条黑带截断。轻柔塑形的下半部向颈部收窄，肩膀和翻领则由宽阔、安静的色面构成。前景人物遮挡了外套和领带，让两人读作紧密的一组，而不是两个孤立的剪影。浅色脸部占据最亮的明度，衬衫和口袋细节补上较小的白色重音，衣服则沉入不同层次的炭黑色。光似乎从左上方照来，使头部显得圆润，并让较高人物脸部及西装的右侧陷入深影。画面表面平滑，带有细微颗粒和缓慢的明度过渡；脸部与黑带相交处边缘清晰，深色衣服与背景相接处则更柔软。整体构图静止而紧密均衡，借黑白几何的强烈对比赋予正式肖像一种奇异、克制的气氛。
style_prompt_en: The digital painting uses a near-monochrome range of velvety black, charcoal gray, and cool off-white. Large, uninterrupted dark fields surround a few pale simplified volumes, so the brightest area is immediately legible without small decorative detail. Smooth tonal modeling gives those light volumes a quiet sense of mass, while broad flat bands interrupt them with precise geometric edges. Dark forms overlap in shallow layers; their boundaries sometimes dissolve into the background instead of being outlined throughout. Soft directional light creates a narrow gray glow and a measured falloff into black, with very little reflected color. Faint fine grain keeps the broad surfaces from appearing perfectly sterile. The visual rhythm moves between upright rounded forms, firm horizontal divisions, and generous negative space. The overall effect is austere and uncanny, with selective sharpness carrying more weight than texture or ornament.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅数字绘画使用接近单色的绒黑、炭灰与冷调灰白。大片连续的深色区域环绕少数浅色简化体块，使最亮的区域无需细小装饰也能立即辨认。平滑的明度塑形让浅色体块带有安静的体积感，宽阔平坦的色带则以精确几何边缘切断它们。深色形体以浅层次互相重叠，部分边界融入背景，没有全程勾线。柔和的定向光形成狭窄灰色光晕，并有节制地衰减至黑暗，几乎没有反射色。细微颗粒让大色面不至于显得全然无菌。视觉节奏在直立的圆润形态、明确的水平分割和宽裕留白之间转换。整体效果严峻而奇异，选择性的清晰边缘比肌理或装饰承担更多视觉重量。
theme_en: Two faceless figures in a dark monochrome formal portrait
theme_zh: 深色单色调正式肖像中的两位无五官人物
name: Tomoo Gokita
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
